name: token-weather
description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt: a weather icon, the fill percentage, and a chart of the last turns.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: on (default) runs the mod; off turns it off everywhere, on every surface (the switch-board panel flips this)

terminal.title: Show in terminal
terminal.description: off (default) draws the forecast only in the desktop app (and other app surfaces); on draws it in the terminal too
